name: mirror
description: Mirror — privacy-first, mobile-first digital behaviour analytics. Monorepo root.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/mobile/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.packages.json
scripts.test: npm run test:tokens && npm run test:prototype && npm run test:ui && npm run test:mockups && npm run test:packages && npm run test:config && npm run test:android && npm run test:release && npm run test:privacy && npm run test:security
scripts.test:ui: node --test packages/ui/tests/ui.test.mjs && node --test packages/ui/tests/a11y-label.test.mjs && node --test packages/ui/tests/import.test.mjs && node --test tests/jsx-no-unescaped.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run tokens && npm run check:lockfile && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run security:secrets && npm run security:bundle
scripts.test:packages: node --test packages/shared-types/tests/*.test.mjs packages/core-analytics/tests/*.test.mjs packages/connectors/tests/*.test.mjs packages/store/tests/*.test.mjs packages/ml/tests/*.test.mjs packages/importers/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:privacy: node --test tests/privacy.test.mjs && npm run privacy:self-test && npm run privacy:addon
scripts.lint: eslint packages/shared-types/src packages/core-analytics/src packages/connectors/src packages/store/src packages/ml/src packages/importers/src packages/ui/src packages/ui/screens packages/ui/mockups apps/mobile scripts tests
scripts.security: npm run lint && npm run security:secrets && npm run security:deps && npm run security:bundle
